answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 176100 Country: India Title: Property distribution Question: My elder brother is passed away last month. He has land and money in the bank also. He has wife and two daughters. We have father, mother and two brothers still alive. How to divide this property as per Sharia law? Answer ID: 176100 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 487/456/M=5/1441) In the question mentioned above the property left by your elder brother (land, money in bank etc.) shall be divided into 27 shares after paying due rights preceding inheritance. Out of total the wife shall get 3 shares, father and mother shall get 4-4 shares while each daughter shall get 8-8 shares. In this case the brothers shall get nothing. The detail of Shariah division is as follows: Details: Wife: 1x3=03 Father: 1x4=04 Mother: 1x4=04 Daughters: 2x8=16 Total: 27 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
